highlights:
Looking for a unique Southern California fishing adventure? Join Coletta Sportfishing for a San Diego lobster charter and experience the excitement of hoop netting California spiny lobster at night. These charters are hands-on, action-packed, and a great way to create unforgettable memories with friends, family, or co-workers.

Experience the Thrill of Lobster Hoop Netting

Unlike traditional rod-and-reel fishing, lobster trips use baited hoop nets set along the San Diego coastline. As the sun sets, we deploy the nets and check them throughout the evening, hoping to haul up California’s prized spiny lobster. You’ll enjoy the anticipation of each pull and the reward of a delicious catch.
